pages.title: Cuvieronius
pages.text: The Cuvieronius ($(o)Cuvieronius hyodon$()) is an extinct gomphothere that lived from southern North America through Central America into South America, disappearing at the end of the Pleistocene.$(br2)Gomphotheres were relatives of elephants. Cuvieronius was smaller than a modern elephant, with distinctive tusks that were twisted in a spiral.$(br2)In South America it lived mainly in the Andes, inhabiting cooler highland environments.
